verdict.rationale: Runloop has no native natural-language interface, but it supports driving the platform through AI assistants. The AI-tools page documents an official MCP server and adding Runloop API context to LLMs, and Cursor rules files cover the SDK. llms.txt and markdown docs are machine-readable, so an external agent could plausibly operate Runloop from natural-language prompts. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface (in the CLI, dashboard or chat), detail on what the MCP server's tools can operate, and hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works end to end.
